# PartyLayer

> CIP-0103 compliant Canton Network wallet connection kit. One React installation includes the SDK, supported wallet runtimes and a branded Connect Wallet UI.

Start with the quick start for the complete installation and provider/button examples. Wallet support depends on the selected network, channel and application configuration.
